hash_note: fetch_sha256 identifies the stored workbook; content_sha256 identifies the row's date and five values, as six-place decimals
role_note: An external check on H7m goalposts 1 and 3, reported and never deciding (Eleonora, 19 October 2026); R and S stay the deciding benchmarks, and nothing reads this series into a goalpost or a score.
vintage_note: The latest release's figures, which may differ from the first print: the Fed serves only its latest workbook, so earlier releases are not recoverable. Each estimate is read as public from the release repo_liquidity.rde.release_for assigns it, never before the launch on 2024-10-17.
